outline: 本課程介紹管理會計和控制等之成本會計概念介紹，本課程之目的在了解管理會計之實務與應用內涵，並藉以設計及發展管理資訊系統另外，本課程也針對與管會相關之介紹(just-in-time, balanced scorecards, profitability center, investment center …等)與管理決策(外包或自製, 增加產品線,績效評估…等)
schedule:
1. Managerial Accounting: An Overview
2. Managerial Accounting and Cost Concepts
3. Job-Order Costing
4. Activity-Based Costing
5. Process Costing
6. Cost-Volume-Profit Relationships
7. Variable Costing and Segment Reporting: Tools for Management
8. Master Budgeting
9. Flexible Budget, Standard Costs, and Variance Analysis
10. Performance Measurement in Decentrialized Organizations
11. Defferential Analysis: The Key to Decision Making
12. Capital Budgeting Decisions
13. Statement of Cash flows
14. Financial Statement Analysis
assessment: For this course, the midterm and final exam is worht thirty points, and the homework assignment is worth forty points.
